title: Continual-adaptation run protocol contract (v1)
description: Metadata-only protocol and manifest contract for a bounded continual-adaptation and revalidation run (issue #6582). It declares the immutable baseline checkpoint identity, the immutable safety-wrapper checksum, the bounded adaptation experience budget, the declared mutable parameter prefixes, the disjoint adaptation/evaluation scenario IDs, the synthetic shift(s), and the nominal/shift/forgetting thresholds. It describes the adaptation protocol only; it never launches training, alters a checkpoint, mutates the safety wrapper, or promotes a policy. The adapted-policy identifier is DERIVED by the validator from the baseline identity plus a normalized adaptation manifest; a manifest must never pre-declare an adapted identifier that could overwrite the baseline.

claim_boundary.description: Human-readable statement that this manifest is metadata-only and makes no execution, checkpoint-write, or promotion claim.

results.description: Optional references to the nominal, shifted, and forgetting evaluation results plus the new evidence bundle. Completeness (all four refs with uri plus a supported checksum, and a distinct non-empty evidence-bundle identifier) is required only when promotion_decision.decision is 'promote' and is enforced by the semantic checker, so a partial results block fails closed at the promotion gate rather than at schema validation.

digest.description: Lowercase hexadecimal digest of the checksummed artifact. Its algorithm-specific canonical length is enforced below so truncated hashes fail closed at schema validation time.

json_value.description: A recursively JSON-serializable value. Shift parameters participate in the canonical manifest digest, so they must not contain YAML-only values such as timestamps.

identifier.description: Immutable baseline checkpoint identifier. The validator derives a NEW adapted-policy identifier from this plus the normalized adaptation manifest and must never overwrite it.

checksum.description: Content checksum of the frozen baseline checkpoint so its identity is immutable across the adaptation run.

identifier.description: Pointer to the safety-wrapper module/code whose immutability this contract declares (e.g. a dotted module path).

checksum.description: Checksum of the frozen safety wrapper. The adaptation job must not modify the wrapper; only this checksum may reference it.

mutation_permitted.description: Must be false. The semantic checker fails closed when this is true so a manifest can never grant the adaptation job permission to mutate the safety wrapper.

allowed_parameters.description: Mutable parameter prefixes the adaptation job is allowed to update (e.g. 'policy_net.head.'). Parameters outside this list are frozen. The semantic checker rejects prefixes that overlap the immutable safety_wrapper.identifier namespace.

bounded.description: Must be true. The semantic checker fails closed when the budget is unbounded.

steps.description: Finite, positive step count for a bounded budget. Null/absent finite value for an unbounded declaration is rejected by the semantic checker.

units.description: Units of the step count, e.g. 'gradient_steps', 'env_steps', 'episodes'.

adaptation.description: Calibration/adaptation scenario IDs. Must be disjoint from evaluation IDs; enforced by the semantic checker.

evaluation.description: Held-out evaluation scenario IDs. Must be disjoint from adaptation IDs so adaptation data is never counted as evaluation evidence.

shifts.description: At least one declared synthetic shift (e.g. friction, payload, latency, pedestrian) tested under the revalidation protocol.

parameters.description: Optional JSON-serializable parameters describing the shift magnitude/direction. YAML-only values are rejected because parameters contribute to the canonical adapted-policy identifier.

nominal.description: Acceptable nominal-performance delta threshold (catastrophic-forgetting guard on baseline conditions).

shift.description: Required shifted-performance improvement threshold under the declared synthetic shift.

forgetting.description: Acceptable catastrophic-forgetting delta threshold on baseline conditions after adaptation.

results.description: Loosely typed at the schema level so a partial block fails closed at the semantic promotion gate. Each ref must carry a 'uri' plus a supported checksum with the canonical digest length for its algorithm; evidence_bundle must also carry a non-empty identifier distinct from the baseline policy. The semantic checker requires all of nominal_result, shift_result, forgetting_result, and evidence_bundle to be present and complete before 'promote' can pass.

evidence_bundle.description: New immutable evidence bundle for the adapted policy; promotion requires a fresh identifier, uri, and supported checksum, and the identifier must not equal the baseline policy identifier.
